title: UPSSSC Moharir 2022 Exam Syllabus

vacancyDetails: Exam syllabus and pattern for Moharir (Clerk-related) Examination – Advt. cycle 2022

2. Open Syllabus / Notification PDF

shortDescription: UPSSSC Moharir 2022 Exam Syllabus – topics and exam scheme overview.
content:
UPSSSC Moharir exam syllabus (2022 cycle) includes general subjects used for clerical / moharir level posts.

Typical topics

  • General Intelligence / Reasoning
  • General Awareness
  • General Hindi
  • Basic Mathematics / Arithmetic
  • Computer knowledge (if in scheme)

Always match preparation with the official advertisement PDF on upsssc.gov.in.
